text:
mike: Heads-up: we rolled the SameSite cookie change to sso-proxy (SameSite=None -> Lax) around 09:12 UTC; post-deploy we're seeing a spike in SCIM backfill jobs creating duplicate user entries and missing audit entries.

sophia: omg, did the deploy include the cookie domain/net change? @jenn any deploy notes?

deploy-bot: deploy finished: sso-proxy v3.4.2 by jenn at 2024-11-15T09:12:03Z :white_check_mark:

jenn: rolled an emergency fix for cross-site POSTs. I only changed SameSite from None->Lax because of a Chrome policy warning. No other behavior expected.

ida: what exact symptom? duplicates or 409s?

mike: duplicates. SCIM provisioning logs show repeated POST /Users with different provisioning request ids; upstream IdP is retrying without session cookie, so the request is treated as unauthenticated webhook and we fallback to backfill flow. Example logs:

```
[2024-11-15T09:18:10Z] req_id=abc123 scim_req_id=req-789 POST /scim/Users 302 set-cookie: sso_session=...; SameSite=Lax; Secure
[2024-11-15T09:18:10Z] provisioning-handler: no session found, triggering backfill for externalId=ext-555
[2024-11-15T09:18:11Z] backfill: created user uid=usr-001 source=backfill
[2024-11-15T09:18:12Z] backfill: created user uid=usr-002 source=backfill
```

paul: also seeing audit log sequence gaps for that time window (09:12-09:25). The writes are happening but audit-events table has missing correlation ids.

sophia: likely because we authenticate session via cookie on proxy for IdP webhook; if cookie not sent due to SameSite change, handler runs unauthenticated code path that doesn't emit audit events. Looks plausible.

mike: can we validate with curl simulating cross-site POST? use `--header 'Origin: https://idp.example.com'` and see cookie behavior.

ida: quick test: `curl -v -H 'Origin: https://idp.example.com' -c /tmp/cookies -b /tmp/cookies https://sso.internal/scim/Users -d '{"schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],"userName":"bob"}'` — on Lax the cookie is not sent for cross-site POSTs.

mike: confirmed locally. Repro steps + screencap saved to /tmp/sso-samesite-repro.txt

jenn: rollback option: revert SameSite to None on proxy until we implement token-based webhook auth for SCIM.

sophia: agreed. also add a monitoring alert: SCIM create rate / unique externalId ratio spike.

paul: I'll backfill audit events for the window from provisioning logs; might need DB write access. tagging @oncall-sec

oncall-sec: got it, will coordinate with infra for rollback window. any PII exposure? looks like duplicate accounts only, no secrets.

mike: patch: adding `X-Sso-Webhook: true` header require for IdP -> will require IdP config. longer term: HMAC signed webhook (recommended by compliance).

jenn: rolling rollback now — ETA 09:40 UTC

deploy-bot: rollback started: sso-proxy v3.4.1 -> v3.4.2-revert at 2024-11-15T09:36:11Z

mike: after rollback SCIM create spikes dropped. audit gaps addressed. putting runbook note: when changing cookie attributes, coordinate scim webhook auth and add canary for unauthenticated backfill.

sophia: created ticket SEC-4820 with steps + add policy to require integration tests for cross-site webhooks before cookie changes.

jenn: closing thread once DB backfill completes. thx :thumbsup:
